arxiv-2204-13833.title: Product decompositions of semigroups induced by action pairs
arxiv-2204-13833.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . This paper concerns a class of semigroups that arise as products U ​ S US , associated to what we call ‘action pairs’. Here U U and S S are subsemigroups of a common monoid and, roughly speaking, S S has an action on the monoid completion U 1 U^{1} that is suitably compatible with the product in the over-monoid.

arxiv-2210-17153.title: Towards Developing State-of-the-Art TTS Synthesisers for 13 Indian Languages with Signal Processing aided Alignments
arxiv-2210-17153.creator: Anusha Prakash, S Umesh, Hema A Murthy
arxiv-2210-17153.description: Abstract End-to-end (E2E) systems synthesise high-quality speech, but this typically requires a large amount of data. As E2E synthesis progressed from Tacotron to FastSpeech2, it became evident that features representing prosody, particularly sub-word durations, are important for error-free synthesis. Variants of FastSpeech use a teacher model or forced alignments for training.

arxiv-2211-01959.title: An agent-based approach to procedural city generation incorporating Land Use and Transport Interaction models
arxiv-2211-01959.creator: Luiz F. S. Eugênio dos Santos 1, Claus Aranha 2, André P. de L. F. de Carvalho 1
arxiv-2211-01959.description: Abstract We apply the knowledge of urban settings established with the study of Land Use and Transport Interaction (LUTI) models to develop reward functions for an agent-based system capable of planning realistic artificial cities. The system aims to replicate in the micro scale the main components of real settlements, such as zoning and accessibility in a road network.

arxiv-2302-01491.title: DiSProD: Differentiable Symbolic Propagation of Distributions for Planning
arxiv-2302-01491.creator: Palash Chatterjee, Ashutosh Chapagain, Weizhe Chen, Roni Khardon
arxiv-2302-01491.description: Abstract The paper introduces DiSProD, an online planner developed for environments with probabilistic transitions in continuous state and action spaces. DiSProD builds a symbolic graph that captures the distribution of future trajectories, conditioned on a given policy, using independence assumptions and approximate propagation of distributions.

arxiv-2307-02235.title: The phase transition for the three-state SOS model with one-level competing interactions on the binary tree
arxiv-2307-02235.creator: Muzaffar M. Rahmatullaev, Obid Sh. Karshiboev
arxiv-2307-02235.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider a three-state solid-on-solid (SOS) model with two competing interactions (nearest-neighbour, one-level next-nearest-neighbour) on the Cayley tree of order two. We show that at some values of parameters the model exhibits a phase transition. We prove that for the model under some conditions there is no antiferromagnetic phases.

arxiv-2309-12988.title: On p p -adic modularity in the p p -adic Heisenberg algebra
arxiv-2309-12988.creator: Cameron Franc and Geoffrey Mason
arxiv-2309-12988.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Cameron Franc and Geoffrey Mason. We establish existence theorems for the image of the normalized character map of the p p -adic Heisenberg algebra S S taking values in the algebra of Serre p p -adic modular forms M p M_{p} . In particular, we describe the construction of an analytic family of states in S S whose character values are the well-known Λ \Lambda -adic family of p p -adic Eisenstein series of level one built from classical Eisenstein series.

arxiv-2311-10930.title: The shadows of accelerating Kerr-Newman black hole and constraints from M87*
arxiv-2311-10930.creator: Tao-Tao Sui a, Qi-Ming Fu b,c, Wen-Di Guo d
arxiv-2311-10930.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the influence of the parameters for the accelerating Kerr-Newman black hole on the shadows and the constraints, extensively. We find that the rotating parameter a a , the charge parameter e e , and the inclination angle θ 0 \theta_{0} affect the shadow qualitatively similar to that of Kerr-Newman black holes.

arxiv-2403-00043.title: RiNALMo: General-Purpose RNA Language Models Can Generalize Well on Structure Prediction Tasks
arxiv-2403-00043.creator: Rafael Josip Penić, Tin Vlašić, Roland G. Huber, Yue Wan, Mile Šikić
arxiv-2403-00043.description: Abstract While RNA has recently been recognized as an interesting small-molecule drug target, many challenges remain to be addressed before we take full advantage of it. This emphasizes the necessity to improve our understanding of its structures and functions. Over the years, sequencing technologies have produced an enormous amount of unlabeled RNA data, which hides a huge potential.

arxiv-2404-10449.title: Numerical investigation of a family of solitary-wave solutions for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation perturbed by third-, and fourth-order dispersion
arxiv-2404-10449.creator: Oliver Melchert, Ayhan Demircan
arxiv-2404-10449.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Oliver Melchert, Ayhan Demircan. We study solitary wave solutions for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation perturbed by the effects of third-, and fourth-order dispersion, maintaining a wavenumber gap between the solitary waves and the propagation constant. We numerically construct members of a family of such solitary waves, including Kruglov and Harvey’s exact solution, using the spectral renormalization method and establish empirical relations between the pulse parameters. A deeper insight into the properties of solitary waves and solitons can be obtained through collisions.

arxiv-2503-18014.title: Search for doubly charmed dibaryons in baryon-baryon scattering
arxiv-2503-18014.creator: Yao Cui 1, Yuheng Wu 2, Xinmei Zhu 3, Hongxia Huang 1, Jialun Ping 1
arxiv-2503-18014.description: Abstract We perform a systematical investigation of the doubly charmed dibaryon system with quantum numbers I ​ J = 01 IJ=01 , and strangeness numbers S = 0 S=0 , − 2 -2 and − 4 -4 in the framework of the chiral quark model.

arxiv-2508-10956.title: ORBIT: An O bject Property R easoning B enchmark for Visual I nference T asks
arxiv-2508-10956.creator: Abhishek Kolari, Mohammadhossein Khojasteh, Yifan Jiang, Floris den Hengst, Filip Ilievski
arxiv-2508-10956.description: Abstract While vision-language models (VLMs) have made remarkable progress on many popular visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks, it remains unclear whether they abstract and reason over depicted objects. Inspired by human object categorisation, object property reasoning involves identifying and recognising low-level details and higher-level abstractions.

pmc-10665186.title: Structure of the native myosin filament in the relaxed cardiac sarcomere
pmc-10665186.creator: Davide Tamborrini, Zhexin Wang, Thorsten Wagner, Sebastian Tacke, Markus Stabrin, Michael Grange, Ay Lin Kho, Martin Rees, Pauline Bennett, Mathias Gautel, Stefan Raunser
pmc-10665186.description: The thick filament is a key component of sarcomeres, the basic units of striated muscle1. Alterations in thick filament proteins are associated with familial hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and other heart and muscle diseases2. Despite the central importance of the thick filament, its molecular organization remains unclear.

pmc-10738565.title: SLEEP PROBLEMS MEDIATE THE ASSOCIATION BETWEEN CHILDHOOD ADVERSITY AND LATE-LIFE COGNITIVE FUNCTIONING
pmc-10738565.creator: SangNam Ahn, Hong Xian, Jeffrey Scherrer, Asos Mahmood, Eunhye Ahn, Seonghoon Kim, McKenzie Beck, George Slavich
pmc-10738565.description: The negative health impacts of childhood adversity have been well documented. However, little is known about the pathways linking childhood adversity with cognitive functioning later in life. We addressed this issue by examining the extent to which lifetime sleep problems mediated the effects of childhood adversity on late-life cognitive functioning.

pmc-11343863.title: Advancing from scalar to vectorial liquid crystal holography: a paradigm shift
pmc-11343863.creator: Yan Li, Shin-Tson Wu
pmc-11343863.description: A versatile and tunable vectorial holography is demonstrated based on single-layer single-material liquid crystal superstructures. This novel approach advances the process from scalar to vectorial holography, opening new opportunities for advanced cryptography, super‑resolution imaging, and many other tunable photonic applications.

pmc-11532788.title: Impact of chronic constipation symptoms on work productivity and daily activity: A large‐scale internet survey
pmc-11532788.creator: Takumi Ota, Shinji Kuratani, Hisanori Masaki, Sonoko Ishizaki, Haruhiko Seki, Takahiro Takebe
pmc-11532788.description: Background and AimChronic constipation negatively impacts work productivity and patients' quality of life. This retrospective study assessed the correlation between symptoms of chronic constipation and work/activity impairment with and without the use of laxative treatment.MethodsThis cross‐sectional, observational, web‐based survey was conducted using the Work Productivity and Activity Impairment‐Chronic Constipation Questionnaire and included Japanese patients with chronic constipation receiving prescribed medication.

pmc-11699243.title: The resilience of ethical assets against different uncertainty shocks
pmc-11699243.creator: Md Bokhtiar Hasan, M. Kabir Hassan, Mamunur Rashid, Tanzila Akter, Humaira Tahsin Rafia
pmc-11699243.description: The focus of this research is to examine the safe-haven properties of seven ethical and conventional asset classes using two sophisticated techniques: quantile coherence and Wavelet coherence. We analyze data ranging from October 3, 2011, to September 30, 2021, that encapsulates several global risk events.

pmc-12498353.title: Sepsis and septic shock caused by Porphyromonas gingivalis: a case report
pmc-12498353.creator: Meifang Lin, Guang Yang, Cong Shen, Yinglun Xiao, Cha Chen, Xuan Zhang
pmc-12498353.description: BackgroundPorphyromonas gingivalis is a predominant pathogen in periodontitis and is closely associated with the progression of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).ObjectiveThis case report aims to describe a case of sepsis caused by P. gingivalis in a patient with COPD and a history of dental pain, highlighting the diagnostic challenges and clinical implications.

pmc-12690724.title: CERG-01 ADULT BRAIN TUMORS : ABOUT 46 PATIENTS OPERATED IN THE NEUROSURGERY DEPARTMENT OF THE NIAMEY NATIONAL HOSPITAL
pmc-12690724.creator: Habi Alizeta Nikiema, Ibrahim Assoumane Issa, Aminath Bariath Kelani
pmc-12690724.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and ObjectivesThe management of brain tumors in resource-limited countries poses enormous challenges. The objective was to determine the epidemiological, clinical and therapeutic profiles of patients operated on for brain tumors at the Niamey National Hospital.Methodologythis is a descriptive study with retrospective collection including adults operated on for brain tumors from January 2018 to September 2023 followed by an anatomopathological examination.Results46 cases were collected. These were mainly patients in the age group of 49 to 58 years. The female gender was predominant.

pmc-12767084.title: Visual Analysis of Hyperglycemia After Enteral Nutrition in Critically Ill Patients
pmc-12767084.creator: Rui Zhang, Jinxing Li, Bo Liu, Zhirong Gu, Hou Qiang Huang, Silin Zheng, Min Huang
pmc-12767084.description: BackgroundEnteral nutrition (EN) is one of the crucial methods in the comprehensive treatment of critically ill patients. However, among critically ill patients receiving EN, hyperglycemia is a common metabolic complication that can lead to adverse clinical outcomes for patients. Therefore, this study aims to provide a comprehensive bibliometric and visual analysis in this field.

pmc-13085057.title: Changing patterns of nitrous oxide use and environmental awareness among Brazilian anesthesiologists: a nationwide cross-sectional survey
pmc-13085057.creator: Leopoldo Muniz da Silva, Rafael Souza Fava Nersessian, Ana Claudia Lopes Fernandes Araújo, Vanessa Melo Silva Torres, Désirée Stieven Machado, Saullo Queiroz Silveira, Fernando Nardy Bellicieri, Caroline Tukasan, Gabriel Silva dos Anjos, Helidea de Oliveira Lima, Glenio B Mizubuti
pmc-13085057.description: BackgroundNitrous Oxide (N2O) is a potent greenhouse gas with significant environmental impact and is currently the leading ozone depleting substance in use. Despite its long-standing role in anesthetic practice, data on N2O use and the environmental awareness of Brazilian anesthesiologists are scarce.

pmc-13381214.title: Integrated post-GWAS, single-cell, and functional analyses prioritize TCTN2 at an osteoarthritis locus associated with innate immunity-related cartilage remodeling
pmc-13381214.creator: Changchun Lu, Lei Wang, Xinqi Cao, Kun Zhao, Nuo Yin, Dong Zhang
pmc-13381214.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPost-genome-wide association study (GWAS) interpretation of osteoarthritis (OA) increasingly requires integration with single-cell biology because many risk loci likely act through sterile inflammatory remodeling, regulatory and inflammatory chondrocyte states, and tissue-stress biology rather than through large disease-stage expression shifts.

pmc-13383582.title: Traumatic pseudoaneurysm of a distal middle cerebral artery branch with findings suggestive of an interdural location: illustrative case
pmc-13383582.creator: Toshiaki Inomo, Eiji Ito, Yusuke Sakamoto, Akiko Ohashi, Mao Yokota, Tadashi Watanabe
pmc-13383582.description: BACKGROUNDTraumatic intracranial pseudoaneurysms are rare, and those located between the dural layers (interdural space) are exceptionally uncommon. The authors describe a delayed pseudoaneurysm arising from a distal middle cerebral artery branch, with multimodal findings most consistent with an interdural location.OBSERVATIONSA 56-year-old man sustained a fall-related head injury with right frontal contusion, frontal bone fracture, and superior orbital wall fractures.

pmc-13632736.title: An immunocompetent, multifluorescent resource for real-time analysis of osteosarcoma progression, metastasis, and response to therapy
pmc-13632736.creator: Taiana C. Leite, Jue Hou, Xuehui Geng, Luigi Mancinelli, Abigail Sedlacek, Devanshi A. Nayak, Karen E. Schoedel, Kurt R. Weiss, Robert J. Binder, Charles P. Lin, Giuseppe Intini
pmc-13632736.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite substantial treatment improvements, the 5-year survival rate for metastatic osteosarcoma (OS) is still as low as 20%. Immunocompetent genetic mouse models of OS have been introduced, enabling in vivo OS studies. Here, we present the ROCCIA mouse, a quintuple-mutant extension of these models that develops multifluorescent OS tumors, allowing distinct fluorescently labeled OS cell populations to be identified and traced both within tumors and in the circulation.

uslaw-usc-t32-s305.title: 32 U.S.C. § 305 — Federal recognition of commissioned officers: persons eligible
uslaw-usc-t32-s305.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t32-s305.description: United States Code, Title 32 (National Guard); Chapter 3 (Personnel). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The following categories are eligible for Federal recognition as commissioned officers of the National Guard: (1) Members of the National Guard. (2) Members of the armed forces. (3) Former officers of the armed forces. (4) Former enlisted members of the armed forces who were discharged honorably.
